cases.question: What are the webpages for the Los Angeles County school that has between 2,000 and 3,000 test takers?
cases.predicted_sql:
SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON s.cds = schools.CDSCode
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.County Name = 'Los Angeles County'
  AND s.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;
